$comment: Searching across every network at once. Search was the last thing in this client that made you name a network before you were allowed to ask a question. Shared by tests/shared/search.test.ts and the Android SharedCorpusTest.
$where: Where a line was said, written the way a person would write it: #channel@network, the same shape as a friend's nick@network. #general is a different room on every network there is.

where.name: a conversation is a place too
where.label: rowan@libera

where.name: a network with no name leaves the channel alone
where.label: #lounge

$order: Newest first, because time is the only order that means anything across networks — each store has its own idea of how well a line matches and those numbers are not comparable. Ties broken by network then channel so a run of lines from one second does not shuffle between searches.

order.name: newest first, whichever network it is on
the same second is ordered by network, then channel
